how: PixelLab drew three round, upright teardrops 3-4 px wide (not slanted streaks), so cropping them could not meet the brief. The script places three slanted streaks pixel by pixel (1 px sideways per 3 rows, top leaning right, ~18 degrees) using only 8 colours sampled from the PixelLab image: darkest blue-grey tail at the top, near-white blue head at the bottom. Nothing scaled; alpha 0 or 255; corners transparent.
variants: 2: 2-px body, 14 rows (right column one shade darker)
